title: pvp-vilager
body:
PvP-Villager Mod

This mod expands Minecraft's villager system by adding new 
professions focused on PvP and combat. Players can trade with 
custom villagers to obtain powerful weapons and gear.

FEATURES

New Villager Professions
- PvP Master villager with unique combat-focused trades
- Supplies villager offering useful materials

Custom Trading
- Trade emeralds and resources for exclusive weapons
- Obtain rare combat items not available through normal crafting

Powerful Weapons
- High-damage custom weapons designed for PvP combat
- Unique tools with enhanced attack stats

Upgradeable Gear
- Use the Smithing Table to upgrade your equipment
- Combine materials to create stronger gear

HOW TO USE
Find or spawn the custom villagers, trade your resources for 
weapon
